title: Faraday discovers electromagnetic induction
summary: In 1831 Michael Faraday showed that magnets and changing currents could produce electric current. On 29 August 1831, in the basement laboratory of the Royal Institution in London, an iron ring wound with two coils produced a brief current in one coil when current passed through the other. Joseph Henry independently made the same discovery in 1832.

uncertainty.note: Ring-coil success dated 29 August 1831 by the Royal Institution; Computer History Museum gives only 1831 for the lectures describing the results.
